request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: initech-003. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: Which devices are consistently low on storage, and how fast are they filling up?","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"insight","restated_question":"Which devices in initech-003 have been persistently below the policy free-disk threshold over the 30-day window, and what is each one's disk-fill rate (trend)?","assumptions":["'Low on storage' means free disk below the disk_low threshold defined in policy.","'Consistently' means the disk_low detector's persistence criterion over the 30-day window, not a single snapshot.","Fill rate comes from the disk_trend detector, not manual arithmetic."],"steps":[{"tool":"get_policy","purpose":"Retrieve the disk_low threshold and persistence definition and the disk_trend parameters to state the definitions used."},{"tool":"run_insights","purpose":"Run disk_low and disk_trend detectors to identify consistently low-storage devices and their fill rates / projected days to full."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
